name: Brenerig (Rig Studio)
what: Browser tool for drag-and-drop rigging and posing of any humanoid model (GLB, GLTF, FBX, OBJ). Place joint markers, bind skin, pose with IK, add extra chains for hair, tails and skirts with physics, play Mixamo clips, sculpt, export GLB.
where: Live: https://brenerig.fly.dev (deploys on push to main, needs FLY_API_TOKEN repo secret)
stack: three.js in the browser, no server logic (nginx static)
studio.js (main), bindworker.js (skin binding in a worker), clips.js (bundled clips)

tools.name: Brenerig
tools.what: Rig, bind, pose, preset poses, pose files (load, save, copy, paste JSON), Mixamo FBX clips, chain physics, sculpt brushes, Export GLB, characters saved in the browser
tools.use_when: Rigging a model by hand for free, fixing a Meshy auto-rig, or making a pose; before paying for a Meshy rig

working: Open model, place markers, bind skin, pose with IK and mirror
Pose files load and save (also reads Pose editor files)
open: Not yet wired as a hub tool beyond a link
rules: Do not push to main without Andrew's OK (it deploys)
avoid_redoing: Rigging and posing UI already exists here: do not build another in Breneland or Brenai
